Scoring 191 runs, the team struggled with key partnerships at pivotal moments. New Zealand triumphed due to significant contributions from Tim Seifert and Glenn Phillips. His key wicket of Finn Allen was crucial for India, although New Zealand's Tim Seifert and Daryl Mitchell formed a vital partnership to stabilize their innings, emphasizing Arshdeep's growing impact in T20 cricket.

title: FREYJA missile shield: Ukraine's new bet against Russian ballistic missiles
description: Ukraine has finalized its contribution to the multinational missile defence system FREYJA, designed for intercepting ballistic missiles. The programme relies on European partners for essential technologies necessary for testing. Initial testing is targeted for late 2026, with battlefield deployment anticipated in 2027. As Russia increases missile and drone attacks, Ukraine seeks to develop an indigenous defence capability.

title: FPIs withdraw Rs 34,843 crore from Indian stocks; second straight month of selling spree
description: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October, continuing a trend. Despite substantial outflows, foreign investors became net buyers towards the end of the month. Market experts suggest that recent foreign buying may indicate a shift in sentiment. Investors are focused on global crude prices and US interest rates influencing markets. The outcome of upcoming events will remain critical for future investment flows.

title: Ishan Kishan breaks Surya's record with historic T20I run spree, joins 2K-run club
description: Ishan Kishan achieved a new milestone, surpassing Suryakumar Yadav's record for most T20I runs in a year by an Indian. In the fifth match against New Zealand, Kishan scored 61 runs off 32 balls. He became the seventh Indian to reach 2,000 T20I runs in 69 innings. Kishan's performance helped India post 191 runs, contributing to their unassailable lead in the series. The match showcased his consistency and attacking play throughout the year.

Their resignations occurred shortly after AAP announced its candidate list for 2027 assembly elections. Pathanmajra has faced legal issues, including a rape case, which has impacted his political standing. The party has appointed Surjit Singh Rakhra as constituency in-charge for Samana amid these developments.

title: 'Why do you challenge democracy?' BJP says Rahul acting on behest of foreign powers
description: BJP leader Nitin Nabin accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi of furthering foreign agendas at a rally in Haryana. Nabin criticized Congress for claiming democracy is at risk only when it loses elections in multiple states. He challenged allegations regarding voter deletion and past election irregularities linked to the party’s leadership. Nabin emphasized the need for governance based on the Constitution rather than dynastic politics.

description: Yuvraj, who has mentored Abhishek and shares a close bond with the left-handed batter, pointed to the way he encourages younger players as one of the signs of his leadership qualities.

title: 110 years after Tennessee river was straightened, 985 acres to be restored
description: Authorities in Tennessee, US, have acquired 985 acres along the South Fork of the Forked Deer River to reduce flooding and restore natural habitats. The river was straightened in 1916 to drain surrounding land, but the changes contributed to flash floods and erosion. The restoration project aims to reconnect the river with its floodplain and eventually open the area to the public.

title: China fossil may reveal first amphibian to live entirely at sea 237m years ago
description: A recent discovery of the fossil Gerrothorax maritimus reveals that some ancient amphibians lived completely in marine environments. Dated to approximately 237 million years ago, this species had a flattened body covered in bony armour. The fossils were found in deep-sea sediments, indicating they lived far from landmasses. Geochemical tests confirmed the strontium isotopes matched those in seawater during the Late Triassic period.

title: GST collections rise 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October
description: October witnessed a remarkable surge in India's Goods and Services Tax revenues, hitting Rs 2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a commendable 22.9% growth from last year. This rise was primarily fueled by a staggering 42.2% increase in imports and consistent domestic transactions. Furthermore, major states contributed positively to these collections, showcasing a resilient economy and improved adherence to tax regulations across the country.

title: 'India not a banana republic': BJP attacks Rahul Gandhi ahead of INDIA bloc rally
description: Union minister JP Nadda accused Congress and Rahul Gandhi of attempting to destabilize the government and create unrest. Nadda labeled the opposition's rally at Ramlila Maidan as a calculated conspiracy against democracy and the economy. He outlined a model of politics involving misinformation and provoking protests. The INDIA bloc, however, claims to mobilize for democratic rights concerning alleged electoral roll irregularities.

title: Sells peanuts till 3 am, in class by 7:30: Student funds his own degree
description: Meet Ariston Era III, a resilient third-year Marine Engineering student who turns to peanut sales to fund his education and family needs. Juggling classes and late-night work, he is inspired by his mother’s values of hard work. With plans to launch a local delivery service and dreams of entering real estate, he remains focused on personal growth, navigating financial obstacles with determination.

title: Pune woman secretly returned from UK; what she told domestic help before her death
description: Mugdha Deshmukh was found dead in her rented apartment in Pune after missing communication with her family. She had returned from the UK without informing them and rarely interacted with neighbors. Concerns arose when her family noticed recent food delivery transactions linked to her location. Police traced her to the Lodha Belmondo complex in Gahunje and gained entry to discover her body.

title: US senators write to Google CEO Sundar Pichai with 9 questions on classroom AI push
description: Two US senators have requested answers from Google CEO Sundar Pichai about the effects of AI tools on children. They highlighted concerns regarding the integration of AI products in schools and their potential negative impacts. The senators have set a deadline for a response by November 2, 2026. They specifically seek information on research conducted about AI's impact on children’s mental health.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio estate faces new security concerns

The dispute comes weeks after reports revealed that Kelce and Taylor Swift installed an audible security system to discourage trespassers. The village's architectural review board has delayed its decision and plans to revisit the revised proposal on November 10.

The incident occurred at Kempegowda International Airport, causing significant distress to his family. Agarwal stated that even his children unknowingly consumed the non-vegetarian food served to them. He requested an investigation by the relevant authorities regarding the matter. Airport officials acknowledged the incident and are currently conducting an internal review to understand the situation.
